title: Khamla SENGMANY (mother)
description: Persona: Somsack's mother, 26, a Lao national living in Lao PDR (Country B) who gave birth in Thailand (Country A). Holds the two paper DVCs from J1 to J3. Goal: have Somsack's care recognised at home without starting over. Needs proof of the vaccines her baby got abroad, clear guidance on when to come back, and not to be penalised for giving birth across the border. Frustrations: paper cards are easy to lose; extra trips to the clinic; the family's records live on her husband's phone (J4). Fictional.
